[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Subordinates** [CSES 1674 · Subordinates](https://cses.fi/problemset/task/1674)

The answer is (subtree size − 1). The natural recursion `size(v) = 1 + sum(size(c))` is $n$ levels deep when the company is a chain, which crashes Python. Instead, list the nodes in an order where every boss comes before its subordinates (a DFS preorder from an explicit stack), then walk that list **backwards**, adding each node's size to its boss.

[Solved in full in @sec-lang-p5-subordinates.]{.card-link}

:::
